results.question: 上月各渠道保费环比
results.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT p.channel_code, SUM(COALESCE(p.premium, 0)) AS premium FROM dwd_premium_month AS p JOIN dwd_policy AS dp ON p.policy_id = dp.policy_id WHERE dp.policy_status = '有效' AND p.stat_month >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND p.stat_month < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1), prev AS (SELECT p.channel_code, SUM(COALESCE(p.premium, 0)) AS premium FROM dwd_premium_month AS p JOIN dwd_policy AS dp ON p.policy_id = dp.policy_id WHERE dp.policy_status = '有效' AND p.stat_month >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND p.stat_month < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.channel_name AS 渠道, ROUND(cur.premium, 0) AS 本月保费, ROUND(prev.premium, 0) AS 上月保费, ROUND((cur.premium / NULLIF(prev.premium, 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS 环比百分比 FROM cur JOIN prev USING (channel_code) JOIN dim_channel AS c USING (channel_code) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200
results.answer: 经纪代理环比百分比 5.54%，个险代理人 5.02%；本月保费合计 29,456,581。

results.answer: 银保渠道的件均保费最高，为 1,333；互联网最低，为 493。共 4 个分组。

results.question: 上月险种保费占比
results.sql: SELECT TRIM(pr.product_name) AS 险种, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.premium, 0)), 0) AS 保费, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(p.premium, 0)) / SUM(SUM(COALESCE(p.premium, 0))) OVER (), 2) AS 占比百分比 FROM dwd_premium_month AS p JOIN dwd_policy AS dp ON p.policy_id = dp.policy_id JOIN dim_product AS pr ON dp.product_code = pr.product_code WHERE dp.policy_status = '有效' AND p.stat_month >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND p.stat_month < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200
